text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — starting ~08:12 UTC we're seeing a steady rise in 429s on the rerank endpoint in eu-west-2. embeddings lane looks fine but rerank queue exploding (~620 pending).

Ashwin Patel: paste queue snapshot?

Maya Chen: here
```
GET /internal/queues?region=eu-west-2
{ "rerank": { "pending": 621, "inflight": 51 }, "embeddings": { "pending": 18, "inflight": 10 } }
```

ops-bot: @channel alert: eu-west-2 rerank 5m-avg 429-rate=16% | autoscale policy "rerank-fastlane" at 100% capacity

Julia Torres: autoscale didn't spin extra nodes. Are burst nodes in maintenance?

Liam O'Neill: checked reservations — rerank commit at 96% of monthly quota. Burst pool exists but 3 nodes are in scheduled maintenance (draining), maintenance window started 07:50 UTC.

Ashwin Patel: can infra flip maintenance? if not, we should route some rerank to embeddings as soft fallback.

Maya Chen: +1 but embeddings expect smaller batch sizes; need admission control changes. Proposal: lower rerank admission qps from 8 -> 5, enable soft-fallback to "embed-approx-v2", and cap cross-lane spill to 15% of embeddings capacity.

Julia Torres: making the change now
```
POST /admin/admission
{"lane":"rerank","threshold":5,"fallback":"embed-approx-v2","spill_cap_pct":15}
```

deploy-bot: queued config update by Julia Torres -> admission-policy (eu-west-2)

deploy-bot: rolled out admission-policy to 6/6 nodes. Monitoring 2m.

Maya Chen: immediate effects: 429s -> 3.6% (5m avg). rerank pending down ~50%. fallback requests show median +110ms.

Liam O'Neill: still need root cause: network team found intermittent egress latency to our london vector-db cluster — RPC p50 jumped to 300ms causing downstream backpressure on rerank workers.

Ashwin Patel: filing INFRA ticket: INFRA-4920. Action items: 1) prefer spinning burst nodes rather than draining during external latency events; 2) add circuit-breaker on vector DB RPCs with fast-fail to fallback model; 3) telemetry to surface cross-lane spill rates.

Julia Torres: also propose a cost-aware override: allow temporary cross-lane routing up to X% of embeddings for up to 30m with explicit audit log. reduces blast radius.

Maya Chen: documenting temporary playbook steps in runbook (runbooks/incident-playbooks): toggle soft-fallback, adjust admission, rollback plan. Will add postmortem notes once infra fixes egress.

ops-bot: incident status: mitigation in place, monitoring. network team investigating egress to london vector-db. Updated 08:28 UTC.
